choices.architecture: Two 256-wide GCN layers, ReLU/dropout after each, mean readout, FC1024/ReLU/dropout then FC512/ReLU are independent choices because complete Table I remains unavailable.
choices.classifier: LIBLINEAR solver2 with bias1 is an independent explicit solver choice; the paper confirms LIBLINEAR but does not resolve this solver/bias pair.
choices.engineering_fixture: Synthetic/random weights,12 nodes,GCN8,FC512,1 epoch; not the production recipe or a dataset score.
choices.fusion: Fixed NWPU alpha0.7 beta0.3 gamma0.4 and the printed C grid are paper-reported values, not fitted to this project's test.
choices.graph: k=10 binary undirected nearest-neighbor union is paper-grounded; Euclidean distance, self exclusion and index ties are explicit engineering choices.
choices.implementation_scope: Independent project recipe; not official code or a verified Table I transcription.
choices.optimization: Adam lr0.001, weight_decay0 and a 100-epoch calibration cap are independent choices; batch100 and factor0.1 every50 epochs follow the readable paper body. Three disjoint branch CE losses are summed.
choices.pooling: Adaptive average pooling to 7x7 is an independent bounded-cost choice, not a confirmed paper value or inherited GAViT setting.
choices.preprocessing: Frozen torchvision VGG16 ImageNet weights and RGB stretch-resize224/448 with ImageNet mean/std are an independent alternative; no MatConvNet numerical-equivalence claim. Random weights are engineering-smoke only.
choices.selection: Validation-only epoch and C selection; selected epoch count is frozen before fresh train+val refit. Test is excluded from selection.
